The '''Kassido Bypass''' was a bypass of the [[Senex-Juvex Loop]] in [[Juvex sector/Legends|Juvex sector]]. It originated at [[Kassido]] and diverted away from the primary hyperlane, where it served at least four minor [[Star system/Legends|systems]], until rejoining with the Loop at [[Malador/Legends|Malador]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Kassido Bypass was included in a map of the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex]] and [[Juvex sector/Legends|Juvex sectors]] in the [[2009]] reference guide ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].
